## Tracking issue

<!-- Required for every PR, including documentation and dependency updates.
Search existing issues first. Reuse the relevant issue or open one describing
the problem, expected behavior, and acceptance criteria before opening this PR.
Link the real issue below. Use "Closes #123" only if this PR fully resolves it;
use "Related to #123" for partial work and list what remains. -->

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Dependency update

## Summary

<!-- Describe what changes for users. -->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem and its impact. For bugs, include reproduction steps,
expected behavior, and actual behavior. -->

- [ ] I reviewed the linked issue and its comments and listed any remaining requests.
- [ ] I reviewed every changed file and explained any new top-level paths or generated files.

## Approach

<!-- Explain the fix and why you chose it. Note alternatives or tradeoffs that
matter to a reviewer. -->

## Scope and remaining work

<!-- State what is complete, what is unfinished, and known limitations.
List concrete follow-up tasks, or write "None." Keep incomplete PRs in draft. -->

## Verification

<!-- Paste exact commands and results. List failed or skipped checks and explain
why any check was not run. For bug fixes, identify the regression test and
whether it fails before the fix and passes afterward. -->

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed behavior, or an explanation is provided
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed

## Demo

<!-- Embed GIFs for every change that can be demonstrated visually, including
bug fixes. Cover every affected interface and relevant mobile layouts. Show
identical steps before and after when existing behavior changes. For new
behavior, show it in use. Briefly explain when a GIF does not apply. -->

<!-- Use GitHub attachments or image URLs pinned to the full commit SHA for
PR-only screenshots and recordings. Keep the referenced commits reachable
before removing any temporary evidence branches. -->

## Maintainer review

- [ ] Review the linked issue, discussion, and complete diff.
- [ ] Reproduce the reported behavior and verify the fix in a representative environment at the commit being merged.
- [ ] Confirm required checks pass at that commit. Repeat affected verification after any changes.
- [ ] Confirm the GIFs cover the affected interfaces or the PR explains why they do not apply.
- [ ] If the PR committed files used only as review evidence, preserve the links and exclude those files from the merge result.

## Compatibility and deployment

<!-- Describe affected web, CLI, desktop, scraper, or notification behavior.
Note provider/site assumptions, rate limits, schema changes, environment
variables, and upgrade steps. Include CLI verification when shared scraper code
changes, and relevant desktop checks when the launcher changes.
Write "None" if there is no deployment or compatibility impact. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched for related issues or PRs
- [ ] No secrets, local environment files, private user data, or generated credentials are included

## Review assistance

Choose one option for unfinished work and changes requested during review.

- [ ] Maintainers may use AI agents to finish the work and prepare follow-up
      changes within the scope below. I will review the result.
- [ ] Maintainers may take ownership and finish the work within the scope below,
      including using AI agents. I do not need to review further changes.
- [ ] I will make the follow-up changes myself. Please leave review comments only.
- [ ] Please ask me before preparing follow-up changes.

Scope, acceptance criteria, and files or behavior that should stay unchanged:

<!-- Describe your constraints, or write "No additional constraints." -->

Maintainers may use AI to review any PR and prepare an independent fix when
needed. Record any preference the author supplied. A blank or conflicting
choice leaves the author's preference unknown. Maintainers decide separately
whether the PR is ready to merge.
